title: orbworlds is really fun
author: Putrid_Doctor5829
selftext:
[https://orbworlds.com/](https://orbworlds.com/)

If u havent checked out orbworlds yet, u are missing out fr. honestly thought it was just another mid prompt-to-game gimmick, but the games u can build on there are actually super fun to play.

instead of getting stuck with clunky controls or broken physics, it uses really good models behind the scenes. u just type out your vision—like an open world, a platformer, or a survival game—and it actually builds a fully playable game with real logic, player accounts, and smooth movement. u can literally tweak stuff in real time just by telling it what u want to change, or u can jump straight into worlds other people built and remix them.

its super chill to use and feels more like playing a sandbox than doing actual work. definitely worth giving it a spin if u just wanna mess around and create something cool without touchin a single line of code.
